parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** may be different for each API request.

parameters.name: NextHop
parameters.description: The next hop of the destination route.

parameters.name: OverlayMode
parameters.description: The tunneling protocol. Set the value to **Ipsec** (IPsec tunneling protocol).

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the VPN gateway instance. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: RouteDest
parameters.description: The destination CIDR block of the destination route.

parameters.name: VpnGatewayId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPN gateway.

parameters.name: Weight
parameters.description:
The weight of the destination route. Valid values:

- **0**: low priority.

- **100**: high priority.
